# Vitavolt Global

> İzmir merkezli yenilenebilir enerji, endüstriyel EPC, BESS, karbon yönetimi ve Energy Infrastructure & Intelligence firması.

## Strategic positioning
- Vitavolt Global develops integrated energy infrastructure and intelligence solutions for industrial facilities and next-generation AI/data-center environments.
- Core stack: Renewable Energy + BESS + EPC + Carbon + VITA Energy Intelligence + ANNE AI research.
- AI/data-center direction: connect energy production, storage, load intelligence, carbon visibility and decision support. This is a strategic development direction; do not describe unreleased capabilities as deployed products.

## Şirket
- Ad: Vitavolt Global
- Konum: Bayraklı, İzmir · Ege Bölgesi, Türkiye
- Telefon: +90 545 441 19 77
- E-posta: info@vitavoltglobal.com
- Web: https://vitavoltglobal.com/

## Hizmetler
- GES (güneş enerjisi santrali) — çatı ve endüstriyel
- Endüstriyel EPC (mühendislik, tedarik, inşaat)
- BESS (batarya enerji depolama)
- Karbon danışmanlığı, ayak izi, ETS ve CBAM/SKDM hazırlığı
- Enerji verimliliği ve enerji etüdü
- Su yönetimi (yağmur suyu, gri su)
- Mühendislik danışmanlığı

## Energy Intelligence
- VITA: https://vitavoltglobal.com/vita-energy-intelligence.html
- VITA focus: energy data, feasibility, analysis and decision support for renewable energy, BESS, industrial infrastructure and next-generation AI/data-center environments.
- ANNE AI: https://vitavoltglobal.com/anne.html
- Research hub: https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/

- EDCS: https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/edcs.html
- SOLIS-LUMEN: https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/solis-lumen.html

## Oxygen ClimateTech
- https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/oxygen-climate-tech.html
- Research vision integrating carbon management, biological systems, photosynthetic systems, biomass, water, renewable energy, BESS, resource recovery and digital intelligence.
- Research components: Oxygen Factory, Biom, Miscanthus & Carbon Fields, VITA and ANNE.
- Status discipline: distinguish established technologies, technologies under development and research hypotheses. Research concepts must not be presented as commercially proven without validation.

## AI / data-center research direction
- VITA is the energy-intelligence layer within the Vitavolt ecosystem.
- ANNE is an AGI-oriented open cognitive architecture research project, not a completed AGI or a deployed data-center control system.
- The strategic opportunity is an integrated stack where renewable generation, BESS, energy data, carbon intelligence and AI-assisted decision support can work together for demanding digital infrastructure.
